theory.title: Would rather, would prefer y prefer para expresar preferencias
theory.explanation: Usa would rather + verbo base para expresar una preferencia actual o futura. Usa would prefer + to + infinitivo. Prefer puede ir seguido de gerundio o infinitivo; utiliza prefer A to B al comparar dos actividades.
theory.tip: Would rather + infinitivo sin to. Would prefer + to + infinitivo. Prefer A to B.

patterns.label: Would rather, would prefer y prefer para expresar preferencias · 1
patterns.pattern: I'd rather watch a documentary tonight.

→ Esta noche prefiero ver un documental.

content.passage: Two friends were planning a quiet evening. Alex would rather watch a documentary, while Sam would prefer to read a book. They both enjoy films, but Alex prefers watching them at home to going to the cinema. Sam would rather not choose a comedy because they had seen several recently. In the end, they agreed to stream a documentary and discuss it afterwards.

items.prompt: Say whether you'd rather watch a film or read a book.
items.modelAnswer: I'd rather read a book because I can imagine the characters and enjoy the story at my own speed. I like films too, but a book gives more detail about what people are thinking.

items.prompt: Describe a programme you would prefer to see.
items.modelAnswer: I would prefer to see a documentary about wildlife. I enjoy learning how animals live and how their habitats are changing. A good documentary can be entertaining and informative at the same time.

items.prompt: Compare listening to podcasts with watching videos.
items.modelAnswer: Podcasts are useful when I'm travelling because I can listen without looking at a screen. Videos are better when I need to see a demonstration. I choose the format depending on what I want to learn.

items.prompt: Ask a friend whether they'd rather go out or stay in.
items.modelAnswer: Would you rather go out for dinner on Saturday or stay in and watch a film? I'm happy with either option, but it would be nice to catch up. We could invite another friend too.

items.prompt: Talk about a kind of film you prefer watching.
items.modelAnswer: I prefer watching comedies and historical films. Comedies help me relax after a busy day, while historical films introduce me to different periods. I don't usually choose horror films because I find them too stressful.

items.prompt: Explain why you would prefer not to use a certain app.
items.modelAnswer: I would prefer not to use an app that collects too much personal information. If the privacy settings are unclear, I don't feel comfortable sharing my details. I would rather use a simpler service.

items.prompt: Describe whether you prefer reading reviews or watching trailers.
items.modelAnswer: I prefer reading reviews to watching trailers because reviews explain the strengths and weaknesses in more detail. However, a short trailer can help me decide whether I like the style of a film.

items.prompt: Talk about what you'd rather do at the weekend.
items.modelAnswer: At the weekend, I'd rather spend one day outdoors and one day relaxing at home. I might go for a long walk on Saturday and cook something special on Sunday. That balance suits me.

items.prompt: Compare two ways of getting news using prefer A to B.
items.modelAnswer: I prefer listening to the radio to watching television for the news because I can do other things at the same time. However, I prefer watching a video when I need to understand a complicated story.

items.prompt: Make three recommendations using would rather and would prefer.
items.modelAnswer: I would rather watch a documentary than a reality show because I learn something useful. I would prefer to see it with subtitles if the speakers have strong accents. I recommend choosing programmes that make you curious.
